mapper.select:
select FINPROD_ID as hidCode, FINPROD_MARKET_ID as code , FINPROD_NAME as shortName from FIN_PRODUCT where 1=1 and FINPROD_TYPE = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F06,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and (FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{finProdMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) OR FINPROD_NAME like concat('%',concat(#{finProdMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')))
select CUSTOMER_ID as id, CUSTOMER_NAME as text from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where 1=1 and IS_ASSTE_MANAGER = #{YES_OR_NO_Y,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select a.FINPROD_ID finprodId, a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, a.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, a.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, a.MANAGER manager, a.CCY ccy, a.VDATE vdate, a.MDATE mdate, a.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, /** modify by yanya on 20210324 基金类型存储在type1**/ /**b.TYPE_6 fundType,**/ b.TYPE_1 fundType, b.TYPE_7 secondType, c.IS_COMPOUND_INT isCompoundInt, d.CUSTOMER_ID manager, f.PAY_TYPE divideMethod, f.PAY_CYCLE carryoverFreq, case when c.PUR_SPEED = 0 then '01' when c.PUR_SPEED = 1 then '02' else '03' end purSpeed from FIN_PRODUCT a left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO d on d.CUSTOMER_ID = a.ISSUER left join FIN_CASH_INFO e on a.FINPROD_ID = e.FINPROD_ID and e.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and e.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FIN_CASH_BUSINESS_TYPE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE f on e.CASH_ID = f.CASH_ID and a.VDATE = f.EFF_DATE , FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE b , FIN_PRODUCT_ADD c where 1=1 and a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_ID = c.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F06,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select a.FINPROD_ID finprodId, a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, a.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, a.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, a.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, a.CALENDAR_ID calendarId, a.IDATE idate, a.CCY ccy, a.VDATE vdate, a.MDATE mdate, a.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, a.MANAGER manager, a.BLN_AREA blnArea, a.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, a.UPDATE_USER updateUser, a.REMARK remark, a.CIRCULATION_CODE circulationCode, a.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE capiIncomeFeature, b.TYPE_2 hsfl, b.TYPE_3 swfl, /** modify by yanya on 20210324 基金类型存储在type1**/ /**b.TYPE_6 fundType,**/ b.TYPE_1 fundType, c.PUR_SPEED purSpeed, c.RED_SPEED redSpeed, c.IS_COMPOUND_INT isCompoundInt, c.TRM_FUND_TYPE trmFundType, c.DATA_SOURCE dataSource, c.INVEST_NATURE investNature, c.TRM_FUND_TYPE trmFundType, d.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, d.DAY_VALUE dayValue, d.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, d.PAY_TYPE payType FROM FIN_PRODUCT a LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE b ON a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD c ON a.FINPROD_ID = c.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE d ON a.FINPROD_ID = d.FINPROD_ID WHERE a.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F06,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE e WHERE d.FINPROD_ID=e.FINPROD_ID AND e.EFF_DATE>d.EFF_DATE)
and a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select CUSTOMER_NAME from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO where CUSTOMER_ID = #{manager,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select distinct c.PAY_TYPE payType, c.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, c.DAY_VALUE dayValue, c.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, c.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, fa.IS_COMPOUND_INT isCompoundInt from FIN_PRODUCT b, FIN_CASH_INFO a left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE c on a.CASH_ID = c.CASH_ID left join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE d on a.CASH_ID = d.CASH_ID left join FIN_RATE_INFO e on e.CASH_ID = a.CASH_ID left join FIN_CASH_PLAN f on a.CASH_ID = f.CASH_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fa on a.FINPROD_ID = fa.FINPROD_ID where b.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.FINPROD_TYPE = #{FIN_CASH_BUSINESS_TYPE_01,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_02,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and a.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C02,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and c.EFF_DATE = b.VDATE

SELECT PARTY_TYPE3 repPartyType3, PARTY_TYPE2 repPartyType2, PARTY_TYPE1 repPartyType1, INDUSTRY repIndustry, INDUSTRY2 repIndustryLevel2 FROM MST_CUSTOMER_INFO_ADD
CUSTOMER_ID = #{issuer,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select a.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, a.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, a.CIRCULATION_CODE as circulationCode from FIN_PRODUCT a where 1=1
and a.CIRCULATION_CODE = #{circulationCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
